crud.description: A complete REST resource from one stub. GET /orders lists, POST creates, GET, PUT, PATCH and DELETE /orders/{id} work on one order. Records are saved and shown in the Data tab.
A second resource with UUID ids. POST /customers without an id and one is generated for you.

stubs.name: Order summary next to the CRUD resource

mockhub.description: A normal stub can live beside a CRUD resource. Priority 1 wins over the CRUD stub, so /orders/summary isn't treated as an order id.
